summary.text: Veronica Sims is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 33 since February 7, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Akron school board member, she is the ranking member of the House Local Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: Veronica Sims graduated from Garfield High School and earned a B.S. in political science and criminal justice and a Master of Public Administration from the University of Akron, according to Ballotpedia.
She has been the special projects and government affairs administrator for Akron Summit Community Action Inc.
Sims served on the Akron Public Schools board of education, at-large, from 2013 to 2016.
The Ohio House of Representatives appointed her to District 33 on February 7, 2024, to replace Tavia Galonski (D).
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the Agriculture, Government Oversight and House Finance committees and is the ranking member of the House Local Government Committee.
Napoleon Rodgers Jr. (R) is the other candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
